name: [Sigma] Credential Stuffing — Multiple Usernames from Single Source
description:
Detects credential stuffing attacks where a single source IP attempts logins
with many different usernames in a short time window. Distinguishes from
brute force (single user, many passwords) by tracking username diversity.
Common pattern from botnet-driven credential reuse attacks.
query:
from cowrie-* metadata _id, _index, _version | where event.action=="cowrie.login.failed" and not source.ip is null
| eval timebucket=date_trunc(10minutes, @timestamp) | stats value_count=count_distinct(user.name) by timebucket, source.ip
| where value_count >= 10
false_positives: Vulnerability scanner running through default credential lists
Internal red team exercise (should be tagged in advance)
